test_process_manager_normal_termination: test the ProcessManager by running multiple processes that terminate normally through all phases
test_process_manager_crash_handling: test the ProcessManager by running processes where one crashes at a specific phase
test_process_manager_exception_handling: test the ProcessManager by running processes where one raises an exception at a specific phase
test_process_manager_hang_handling: test the ProcessManager by running processes where one hangs and gets killed by the manager
run_proc_simulated_process: run the proc function to simulate a managed process transitioning through STARTING, READY, RUNNING, STOPPING, and TERMINATED phases
